description: This file contains prototype declarations for internal functions of the Bwsp Site Creator Object used in the Broadway Web Service Plane Implementation. It includes functions for managing interfaces, properties, and web host/servlet attachments.

methods.name: BwspScoGetWebHemIf
methods.description: Getter for the Web Hem Interface handle

methods.name: BwspScoSetWebHemIf
methods.description: Setter for the Web Hem Interface handle

methods.name: BwspScoGetBwspWsrIf
methods.description: Getter for the BWSP WSR Interface handle

methods.name: BwspScoGetBwspCspIf
methods.description: Getter for the BWSP CSP Interface handle

methods.name: BwspScoGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the site creator object

methods.name: BwspScoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties of the site creator object

methods.name: BwspScoResetProperty
methods.description: Resets properties of the site creator object to default

methods.name: BwspScoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the object

methods.name: BwspScoEngage
methods.description: Activates or starts the site creator object

methods.name: BwspScoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the site creator object

methods.name: BwspScoWsrDetachWebHost
methods.description: Detaches a web host by name

methods.name: BwspScoWsrAttachServlet
methods.description: Attaches a servlet descriptor to a host

methods.name: BwspScoWsrDetachServlet
methods.description: Detaches a servlet from a host by name and path
